source: DfE, Special educational needs in England, academic year 2025/26, published 11 June 2026, Explore Education Statistics: pupils in all schools by type of SEN provision, and pupils with an EHC plan by primary type of need

dataSets.title: Pupils in all schools, by type of SEN provision - 2016 to 2025 - 2026 format
Ethnicity by type of SEN provision and type of need - 2016 to 2025 - 2026 format

methodology: Pupils with an EHC plan and DfE's percentage of pupils, all schools, 2025/26, from the provision data set (school type, phase and hospital school totals). Five-year growth compares 2025/26 with 2020/21 in the same data set. Primary need is the share of pupils with an EHC plan in each primary type of need, from the ethnicity data set at its ethnicity and phase totals, which covers state-funded and non-maintained special schools only.
caveat: SEND is run by upper-tier councils, so district pages show their county. Figures count pupils on the January school census who have an EHC plan; plans held by children under school age, young people in further education and those not in school are not included. The autism figure is the share of pupils with an EHC plan whose primary need is autism, not a prevalence in the population. Rising numbers may reflect identification, diagnosis and parental awareness as well as need.
